##: The zip is a PyInstaller onedir tree compressed whole, so `flow` is a directory
inside it and the exe is at `flow\flow.exe` rather than at the root. No
`extract_dir` here on purpose: the archive is unpacked as it is, which keeps every
path below identical to the path inside the zip, so one reading of
`hash` is the checksum the release published beside the zip for the version above,
or the placeholder FILL-ME-SHA256 between a version bump and that version's zip.
packaging/PUBLISHING.md has the one-liner that fills it, and the manifest will not
install while it holds the placeholder. `autoupdate.hash` reads the `.sha256` the
release workflow uploads beside the zip, so a version bump does not have to
download 142 MB to learn one number.
